ruleset.name: 0x88 app-origin cache policy
ruleset.description: Explicit cache eligibility for app-origin fallback assets

rule.description: Cache app-origin engine, model, and ORT fallback assets
rule.expression: (http.host eq "0x88.app" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ort/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/models/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/engines/")))
